prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Frosted Glass
prompts.summary: Turns a photo into a minimalist frosted-glass abstraction of the scene — translucent panes, soft haze, and the photo's own colors brightened on ivory. The source post shows 12 examples; all 12 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Notebook Hand-Drawn
prompts.summary: Redraws a photo as a fineliner ink illustration on warm-white notebook paper — restrained hatching, deliberate blank space, and just three of the photo's own colors laid down as loose abstract blocks behind the linework. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Blue-Red Risograph
prompts.summary: Recomposes a photo as a two-color Risograph editorial illustration — only deep ultramarine blue and warm coral red on ivory paper, with print grain, halftone and slight registration offsets. The source post shows 12 examples; all 12 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Impasto Oil Painting
prompts.summary: Repaints a photo's strongest subject in thick, sculptural impasto oil paint — palette-knife ridges and vivid saturated color — against generous warm-white negative space. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Flat Silhouette
prompts.summary: Re-edits a photo into flat, outline-free silhouettes clustered on a deep dark ground — dusty pastel-gray shapes with exactly one bright warm off-white focal silhouette and a dry-gouache grain. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Bright Illustration
prompts.summary: Recomposes a photo as a bright minimalist illustration — geometric shapes and flat color blocks in the photo's freshest colors on airy warm white, like sunlight coming in. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Small Illustration
prompts.summary: Shrinks a photo's most recognizable subject into a tiny charcoal-and-rust-red spot illustration on a huge field of warm off-white paper — beauty in what is not drawn. Reel-only post: it has no photo set, so this entry has no reference images.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Blueprint (Cyanotype)
prompts.summary: Re-exposes a photo as a handmade cyanotype: deep Prussian-blue paper, the subject in luminous pale ivory, fibers and uneven exposure kept — and a strict rule against inventing decorative botanicals. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Woven Tapestry
prompts.summary: Re-weaves a photo as a minimal jacquard tapestry: extract its 2–5 strongest memory points, remove 70–90% of the rest, and rebuild what remains from warp-and-weft yarn in 6–8 colors. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Rough Brushed Lines
prompts.summary: Redraws a photo's dominant subject as a large hollow contour in one signature accent color on pure black, with worn dry-marker strokes — the photograph chooses the color. The source post shows 12 examples; all 12 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Woodcut Print
prompts.summary: Re-carves a photo as a limited-color woodcut on warm paper — hand-cut marks, breaks and missing ink, in a soft bright palette of cream, mist green, light blue and coral. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: High-Saturation Paper-Cut
prompts.summary: Rebuilds a photo from large bold shapes of saturated colored paper on warm cream — geometric cut-paper illustration with mid-century character, details simplified, emotion more vivid. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Retro Film (CMYK Halftone)
prompts.summary: Reprints a photo as a bold CMYK halftone editorial poster — visible print dots and rosettes in hot yellow, orange and red, nothing faded. The source post (posted twice; same 11 posters) shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Out of Frame
prompts.summary: Lets a photo spill out of its frame: a small irregular painted color field on big white paper, the subject simplified inside it — with a few contours bleeding past the field's edge. Reel-only post: it has no photo set, so this entry has no reference images.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Mediterranean Travel Poster
prompts.name_original: 老電影裡地中海旅行海報
prompts.summary: Reimagines a photo as a 1930s–60s Mediterranean travel poster — big flat fields of cobalt blue, ivory, olive and terracotta, lithograph grain, sunshine and sea breeze. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: One-Line Contour
prompts.summary: Keeps a photo's most evocative moment with just a few flowing contour lines and one muted spot color on white — posture and feeling over detail. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Clean Illustration Poster
prompts.summary: Reorganizes a photo's most memorable subject into a simple, clean color-block illustration on rice-white — a bespoke poster or travel souvenir card for an everyday photo. Reel-only retrospective roundup: it has no photo set, so this entry has no reference images.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Dynamic Field Print
prompts.summary: Dissolves a photo's subject into one dynamic field of fine lines, broken trajectories and sandpaper grain — densest at the core, fragmenting into white space — in a single signature color. The source post shows 11 images (10 distinct posters; 'AHEAD' is uploaded twice); all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Ink-Starved Geometry
prompts.summary: Declutters a photo to one core motif locked into a rigorous geometric framework, printed with broken ink and worn rubbing texture inside crisp boundaries. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Asymmetric Enlargement
prompts.summary: Rebuilds a photo as a flat editorial character poster — smaller heads, longer limbs, big color blocks — with exactly one element enlarged 35–60% to break the original proportions. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Fine-Line Poster
prompts.summary: Leaves a photo with only a few fragile, broken fine lines and one handwritten phrase — the subject tiny in vast warm-white space, the feeling kept rather than the scene. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Vintage Lines
prompts.summary: Takes a photo apart into boxes, circles and straight black lines plus two spot colors — a mid-century vernacular diagram, like an old advertising card or product manual. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Storytelling Collage
prompts.summary: Re-tells an everyday photo's story as a geometric collage of bright shapes and white space — a numbered editorial poster for an ordinary moment. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here. A close relative of clean-illustration, but a different prompt.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Atmospheric Pixel Art
prompts.summary: Rebuilds a photo as a dreamy retro-RPG pixel scene — small subject, wide sky and mist, pastel palette — preserving the remembered image rather than pixelating it. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Patchwork Embroidery
prompts.summary: Re-sews a photo from fabric patches and thick, frayed hand stitching on a linen ground — imperfect like real handwork, quiet and collectible. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Ink Rubbing
prompts.summary: Turns a photo into an archaeological ink rubbing — broken ink, missing patches and vast paper whitespace, as if the moment were carved in stone and preserved. The source post shows 8 examples; all 8 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Paper Collage Lines
prompts.summary: Re-sorts a photo into torn-paper collage pieces, printed-text fragments and hand-drawn pencil lines — the same photo, rearranged rather than redrawn. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: White Model
prompts.summary: Deletes a photo's background, color and detail until only its essential form remains, rebuilt as a small white architectural concept model in vast empty space. The source post shows 12 examples; all 12 are archived here (the style was posted twice; archived from the fuller posting).

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Paper Carving
prompts.summary: Remakes a photo's world as a layered paper-carving relief — cut, stacked and hollowed paper with real depth, in the photo's brightest colors. The source post shows 12 examples; all 12 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Japanese Bento
prompts.summary: Rebuilds an image inside a clear convenience-store bento box, substituting every element with ingredients while keeping the scene's soul — label, price and barcode included. All 6 set examples apply it to company logos; all 6 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Perler Beads
prompts.summary: Re-assembles a photo's subject from real fuse beads — center holes, thickness and plastic texture — beside the untouched photo, with a 3–5 color card and a poetic Chinese title. The source set shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Blurry Soft Focus
prompts.summary: Keeps the photo above and turns its lower half into a memory left by light — a tiny blurred silhouette in vast soft negative space. Weak subject, strong atmosphere. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Colored-Paper Collage
prompts.summary: Organizes a complex photo into a few flat geometric color blocks on warm ivory — the real world above, an organized visual memory below. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Lingering Afterglow
prompts.summary: Deletes almost everything from a photo until only a tiny indigo line vignette remains on warm paper — the photo records the day; the drawing records how it felt. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Photocopier Print
prompts.summary: Re-prints a photo in two spot colors with deliberate misregistration, ink breaks and grain — a small stamp-like subject in a sea of white. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Food Poster
prompts.summary: A templated prompt (brand, food, headline, interaction, color, product, price): real food winds around, cracks, drips down or peels open oversized black Chinese characters on warm cream. The source post shows 18 examples; all 18 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Porcelain Collage
prompts.summary: Shatters a photo's most memorable moment and reassembles it from Chinese porcelain shards — cracks, chips and missing pieces kept on purpose. The source set shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Black Line Drawing
prompts.summary: Shrinks a photo's most story-worthy fragment into a tiny black-line and watercolor sketch on xuan paper, with one ice-blue accent drawn from the photo. The source post shows 11 examples; all 11 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Geometric Poster
prompts.summary: Pairs a photo with a flat geometric reinterpretation of the same scene in colors pulled from the photo — an exhibition-poster look with a title and year. The source set shows 6 examples; all 6 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Passport Ticket
prompts.name_original: 復古護照 × 登機證 × 旅行紀念票券
prompts.summary: Condenses a travel photo into a vintage passport / boarding-pass souvenir ticket on old paper — flag, postmark, gate and seat included. The source post shows 9 examples; all 9 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Paper-Cut Collage
prompts.summary: Rebuilds a photo's key subject as cut-paper shapes on a split color field — white space above, one solid color band below, the subject at the boundary. The source post shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.

prompts.author: Emerson post
prompts.name: Hand-Drawn Feel
prompts.summary: Keeps only the detail that makes you remember the day and redraws it as a loose, naïve picture-book illustration — shaky lines, crayon grain, one broad color field underneath. The source set shows 10 examples; all 10 are archived here.
